newsitem.title: USA: GenRad backs fiscal 97 analysts' EPS view. [CORRECTED 00:55 GMT 11/3]
newsitem.headline: GenRad backs fiscal 97 analysts' EPS view. [CORRECTED 00:55 GMT 11/3]

text.p: GenRad Inc said on Monday it reiterates its full-year 1997 analysts' estimates of $220 to $240 million in revenue and earnings of $1.25, in addition to a deferred tax adjustment.
The company said it guided analysts first quarter earnings estimates to between $0.20 to $0.25, excluding one-time charges.

The company cited increased selling, general and marketing expenses expected to be incurred only in its first quarter of 1997. Anaylsts continue to expect revenue targets of $48 to 50 million for the first quarter of 1997.
GenRad also confirmed it is not aware of any unusual corporate developments.

"We are encouraged by the sales and order activity from both our Electronic Manufacturing Systems and Advanced Diagnostic Solutions businesses and fully expect to continue the year with the same momentum as ended the 1996 fiscal year," President and Chief Executive James Lyons said.
